messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> genqueue: partial degradation detected in us-west streaming path; increased 5xx for /v1/stream endpoints. Paging @oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: I’m on it. pulling logs + checking genqueue nodes. any immediate customer impact flags?

triage-nina: Alerts show elevated 502/504 from head nodes, traffic spike from batch ingestion at 12:41 UTC. No CPU OOMs on hosts, but backpressure on dispatcher.

ops-maria: Recreating minimal statuspage draft here for quick review. please thumbs-up if okay, otherwise annotate.

ops-maria: ```
Status update - Investigating: We are investigating elevated errors affecting streaming generation (us-west region). Some requests to the /v1/stream endpoints may fail with 5xx. Our on-call team is actively diagnosing and working on mitigations.
- Impact: Intermittent 5xx for a subset of streaming requests in us-west.
- Mitigation: Rolling restart of a subset of genqueue dispatcher pods; routing fallback to eu-central for critical workloads.
- ETA next update: 15 minutes.
```

cs-lee: Adding customer-facing clarity: call out affected features (streaming chat, realtime SDK). Also include recommended workaround: retry with non-streaming endpoint or route to eu for critical requests.

legal-sam: Quick legal check: fine to say "investigating" and "rollback/reroute" actions. avoid promising ETA beyond best-effort. keep "ETA next update" language.

l10n-jun: Will need a one-sentence localized line for JP/FR. Can we keep the core copy <140 chars for banner?

eng-ryan: Cause suspicion: dispatcher thread pool exhaustion due to KV-cache eviction storm. I’ll confirm if cache thrash metrics spike and push a config clamp to reduce max inflight.

oncall-alex: Doing a targeted restart of dispatcher-3 in us-west-2 now. will monitor tail logs.

incident-bot: ACTION -> restart dispatcher-3 initiated by oncall-alex at 6354812065.

ops-maria: Update draft for first periodic update (10m):

ops-maria: ```
Update 1 - Mitigation in progress: We performed a targeted restart of one dispatcher pod; error rates have decreased ~40% in the last 5 minutes but remain elevated for some streaming sessions. We are implementing a temporary routing policy to send new streaming requests to eu-central while mitigation continues.
- Impact: Reduced but still intermittent 5xx for existing in-flight streams.
- Next step: Apply cache throttle and observe for 10 minutes.
- ETA next update: 10 minutes.
```

triage-nina: Metrics show KV-cache eviction rate was 6x baseline between 12:40-12:44 UTC. that aligns with eng-ryan's theory. good to mention observed metric.

eng-ryan: Applying cache throttle now (config key: genqueue.cache.max_inflight=500 -> 250). patch rollout started.

incident-bot: ACTION -> config rollout started by eng-ryan at 6354812180.

cs-lee: Notifying top 10 affected customers with temporary workaround steps. sending copy to ops-maria for inclusion on the statuspage customer note.

ops-maria: Adding brief customer note snippet: "If you are experiencing failures, retry or switch to non-streaming endpoints. We are routing new streaming requests from us-west to eu-central until resolved."

l10n-jun: For JP/FR: I’ll prepare short translations once final copy locked. please mark final with :lock:.

incident-bot: METRIC -> KV-cache eviction rate normalized to 1.2x baseline at 6354812260.

oncall-alex: Error rate now down to ~10% of peak. retaining routing fallback for another 5 minutes to drain.

ops-maria: Draft resolve notice (for approval):

ops-maria: ```
Resolved - Incident resolved: We have applied a cache throttle and completed rolling restarts of affected dispatcher pods. Error rates returned to normal and routing fallback to eu-central has been removed.
- Time resolved: 2026-03-17T12:53:07Z (UTC)
- Cause: KV-cache eviction storm causing dispatcher backpressure; mitigation included cache throttle and targeted restarts.
- Impact: Intermittent 5xx for streaming endpoints in us-west; customer workaround: retry or use non-streaming endpoints.
- Follow-up: engineering will run a post-incident RCA and consider persistent cache limits.
```

legal-sam: OK to publish Resolve. keep RCA language high-level as written.

cs-lee: Confirmed customer outreach complete. no escalations outstanding.

l10n-jun: Marking final and generating JP/FR text now. :white_check_mark:

eng-ryan: Will open RCA ticket and link to postmortem.

oncall-alex: Closing pager and clearing oncall handoff note. great job everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: NOTE -> Thread closed; statuspage publish sequence completed at 6354812387.
